# Carrd

> Carrd is a free, fully responsive one-page website builder for creating simple sites with templates, forms, and integrations.

Carrd provides an intuitive platform for building personal portfolios, landing pages, and one-page sites without coding. The service offers both free and Pro plans with features like custom domains, email forms, and integrations with popular services like Mailchimp, Stripe, and Google Analytics.

## Key Topics

- One-page sites
- Website builder
- Responsive design
- Templates
- Forms
- Custom domains
- Email integrations
- Mailchimp
- ActiveCampaign
- Google Analytics
- Stripe
- Contact forms
- Free plan
- Pro plan
- Social links
